facts.business: MBL Infrastructure Limited is an Indian infrastructure company engaged in road construction and related civil engineering projects, capitalising on India's infrastructure growth opportunities.

auditor.name: SARC & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on non-current investments in subsidiaries MBL (MP) Toll Road Company Limited (Rs 1,500 lakhs), MBL Projects Limited (Rs 3,984.25 lakhs), and aggregate investments of Rs 23,615.23 lakhs in wholly owned subsidiaries including MBL Highway Development, where recoverability is assessed based on resolution plans, arbitration claims, and fair value of underlying assets.

key_risks: Recoverability of investments in subsidiaries under insolvency or with cancelled projects
Dependence on arbitration/litigation outcomes for claims on terminated projects
Forward-looking statements subject to risks, uncertainties, and inaccurate assumptions
facts.related_party_note: None of the transactions with related parties were in conflict with the Company's interest. Details form part of notes to audited financial statements. Policy available at https://www.mblinfra.com/uploadimages/pdf/pdf_1777120291.pdf
